answer.value: The card has no dedicated limitations section. It notes only two narrow technical points. In Thinking mode, undesired repetition can occur, and it recommends do_sample=True and temperature=0.6 to mitigate it. LMDeploy does not yet support GPT-OSS, so vLLM is recommended for the 20B-A4B model.
quotes: When enabling Thinking mode, we recommend setting `do_sample=True` and `temperature=0.6` to mitigate undesired repetition.
However, for InternVL3.5-20B-A4B, we recommend using vLLM since lmdeploy has not yet supported GPT-OSS.
